description: The single graph-scoped selection store, its serialisable selection keys, and the legacy canvas.selectedItems view that adapts it for LiteGraph callers. Canvas gestures that change selection stay in the graph canvas domain.

characterizationScenarios.name: Selection keys and the ordered selection store stay the single source of selected items
Canvas selection gestures and group selection keep selected items in sync

compatibilityPromises: canvas.selectedItems and entity selected flags keep reading from the selection store for existing extensions.
Inventory grants no new cross-domain permissions; graph-model and canvas imports of the selection store remain inherited debt.
